description: Start the preview of a site folder with no command: BitPull finds what it is (plain HTML, Node.js, Python with Django, Flask, FastAPI or Streamlit, PHP), installs what it needs (Node.js, uv and Python, the packages) and starts it. Returns a job; follow it with preview_job until it gives the address or an error with the program's last lines.
name: bitpull_start_preview
